title: Savesta: Video & Status Saver
summary: Download TeraBox, Diskwala, Instagram, FB, X, videos and WhatsApp status.
description:
Savesta is a fast and simple video downloader and status saver app that supports TeraBox, Diskwala, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, X, and WhatsApp Status links.

With Savesta, you can download supported videos, reels, memes, cloud files, and status media in one clean and lightweight app. Paste a supported link, preview or stream videos where available, and save media directly to your phone.

Key Features

• Video Downloader
Download supported videos from popular platforms using a simple paste-link flow.

• TeraBox Downloader
Paste a supported TeraBox link and download videos or files easily. You can also preview or stream supported videos before downloading where available.

• Diskwala Downloader
Download supported Diskwala videos and files directly to your phone with a smooth and simple flow.

• Instagram Reel & Video Saver
Save supported Instagram reels, videos, and media links directly to your device.

• Facebook Video Downloader
Download supported Facebook videos using a shared video link.

• Reddit Video Downloader
Save supported Reddit videos and media links easily.

• X Video Downloader
Download supported videos from X links with a simple paste-link flow.

• WhatsApp Status Saver
Save WhatsApp Status photos and videos that you have already viewed.

• Meme & Short Video Saver
Save memes, funny videos, short videos, and shareable media content for later use.

• Download Manager
Access all saved videos, files, reels, memes, and status downloads in one place. Play, share, repost, or delete media easily.

• WhatsApp Direct Message
Send WhatsApp messages without saving the phone number.

Why Choose Savesta?

• Supports TeraBox and Diskwala links
• Supports Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, and X video links
• Save reels, videos, memes, files, and WhatsApp Status
• Stream or preview supported videos before downloading
• Simple paste-link download flow
• Clean and lightweight design
• Easy download history
• Fast media saving experience
• Built for daily use

Savesta helps you download supported videos, save reels, download TeraBox videos, save Diskwala files, download Instagram and Facebook videos, save Reddit and X videos, save WhatsApp Status, and keep all your media organized in one place.

Whether you want to save a reel, download a video, keep a meme, manage cloud link downloads, or save a WhatsApp Status, Savesta gives you a simple and easy experience.
